long_biography.plain_text:
Papanastasiou spent more than a decade driving marketing, sales and business development at Trading Point Group, the financial-services group behind XM and Trading.com. By 2023 he was an indirect owner and executive director, with responsibility for chief marketing and sales. His role later shifted from aggressive growth to mentoring XM's senior managers. Constantinos Cleanthous and Ilias Mavrommatis founded XM; Papanastasiou's documented contribution was commercial leadership.

Beyond online brokerage, Papanastasiou invests across quantitative finance, financial analytics, hospitality and film. He became a shareholder in Darqube during a 2022 investment round and founded ENA Foundation in Limassol to support social inclusion and opportunity in Cyprus. These ventures broaden his portfolio, but the clearest documented source of his business success remains his ownership and operating career within Trading Point and XM.
